scoring_justification: T1 recompute impossible: checker cannot re-run DFT from the reported summary JSON. Scoring uses structural constraints (ordering, activation energy threshold, bond-length threshold) and absolute-value tolerances against paper-reported DFT results (T0).

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for DFT computed quantities (energies, bond lengths).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper (ACS Appl. Mater. Interfaces 2018, DOI 10.1021/acsami.8b02367) – Results and Discussion / DFT calculation section. Bare C≡N 1.17 Å, state ii C≡N 1.45 Å, state i energy –0.285 eV, state ii energy –1.167 eV, red FS 0.075 eV, blue FS 0.01 eV, red iv –0.013 eV, red v –3.277 eV, blue vi 0.981 eV, blue vii –4.206 eV.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct transcription from the paper's published computational results.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported DFT numbers; they constitute the reproduction target and are used as the hidden comparison gold.

required.cell_params: object (with keys a, b, c in Angstrom)

outputs.description: Scoring compares each energy and bond length against paper-reported reference values using predefined tolerances, and checks that the red pathway is energetically preferred over the blue pathway (structural ordering).

output_contract.notes: All energies are in eV and bond lengths in Angstrom. The checker will apply tolerances appropriate for DFT re-computation and verify relative ordering to determine the minimum energy pathway.
